A.why: Literal code: ('foo', ?) keeps the literal, prepareStatement(sql), setString(1, param), executeUpdate(). Every placeholder bound.

B.why: Literal calls with arguments inline: connection.prepareStatement("... ('foo', ?)") and setString(1, param). One placeholder, bound.
